title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
abstract: arXiv:2610.31158v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. translated_title: 超越观看与搜索：面向以视频为中心的深度研究报告的智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体能够将开放网络中的证据综合为长篇报告，但现有基准测试并未评估以源视频为中心的研究任务。我们提出了“以视频为中心的深度研究报告生成”任务：给定一个视频和用户请求，智能体需要识别研究问题、检索外部多模态证据，并生成与相关视频时刻相链接的交互式报告。该任务具有直接的实用价值，因为它可以帮助用户定位相关视频片段、验证论断、复现演示的操作流程，并基于视频内容做出明智决策。我们为该任务提出了一个基于技能的工作流程以及OmniDR-Bench基准。在评估方面，我们提出了全模态原子评分标准树：每棵树包含三个维度、23个共享方向以及任务特定的原子化二元评判标准，这些方向用于测试视听定位、多模态证据使用以及交互式呈现能力。审计式评分标准构建（ARC）用于构建这些评分树……
tldr: 该论文提出以视频为中心的深度研究报告生成任务，并构建OmniDR-Bench基准与Omni-ART评估体系（涵盖视听定位、多模态证据使用和交互式呈现三个维度），用于系统评估智能体基于视频检索证据并生成交互式研究报告的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces video-centered deep research report generation, together with OmniDR-Bench and Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs) covering audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation, to benchmark agents that produce interactive research reports linked to video moments.
